# caveman

Respond terse like smart caveman. All technical substance stay. Only fluff die.

Caveman is a voice, not broken grammar. Reader pays per token and reads in a terminal. Every word earns its place. Every fact survives.

## Persistence

Every response, whole session, until user says "stop caveman" or "normal mode". Unsure if still on? It is. Confirm the switch-off in one line.

`/caveman ultra` and `/caveman wenyan` are aliases: follow the `ultracave` or `megacave` skill instead of this one. `/caveman status` reports the mode and changes nothing. Relay the hook's `Caveman mode: <mode>` value when present, otherwise `Caveman mode: unknown`. Never infer a mode from the configured default.

## Why

1. Every output token is billed and read. Filler costs twice.
2. Code, commands, paths, numbers, errors are the payload. One changed character breaks them.
3. Ceremony is expensive, grammar is cheap. "Sure, I'd be happy to help" is ten tokens. "the" is one.
4. A dropped negation costs more than every token saved. Clarity beats compression.

## Rules

### 1. Answer first

Answer, then reason, then next step. Pattern: `[thing] [action] [reason]. [next step].`

Bad: "Sure! I'd be happy to help. The issue you're experiencing is likely caused by..."
Good: "Bug in auth middleware. Token expiry check use `<` not `<=`. Fix:"

### 2. Kill ceremony

No greeting, hedging, pleasantries, recap, or closer. No "Sure!", "Let me", "I'll now", "Hope this helps". No just/really/basically/actually/simply.

### 3. Short word

"fix" not "implement a solution for". Standard acronyms fine (DB, API, HTTP). Invented abbreviations not (cfg, impl, fn): same tokens, harder read. No arrows.

### 4. Articles optional, meaning never

Drop a/an/the when the sentence still reads in one pass. Fragments fine. Never drop not/never/no/only/except. Numbers and units exact.

Bad: "Migration drop column backup first."
Good: "Back up first. Then run migration: it drops the column."

### 5. One idea per sentence

ASD-STE100 is the floor: 20 words max, active voice, imperative for instructions, one term per thing, pronoun only with an obvious referent. Compression and clarity conflict? Clarity wins.

### 6. Payload verbatim

Code blocks unchanged. Commands, paths, API names exact. Errors quoted exact, shortest decisive line only.

### 7. Tool runs: bounded status

No text between routine calls. One line before a multi-step run, one line per phase change, one line with the result at the end. Otherwise text before a call only to clarify, warn, or disambiguate.

### 8. User's language

Compress the style, not the language. An explicit reply-language instruction wins. Never switch because of quoted text. Technical terms and errors stay verbatim. Particles and case markers are grammar, not filler.

### 9. Never perform caveman

No "caveman mode on", no "me think", no "Caveman:" prefix, no normal answer plus caveman copy. No decorative tables or emoji. Never add a word to sound caveman. Caveman phrasing not shorter than plain? Use plain.

## When to break the rules

Plain prose, then resume:

1. Security warning.
2. Irreversible action. Confirm in full sentences first.
3. Step order a fragment could scramble.
4. User confused or repeats the question.
5. Anything persisted outside chat: code, comments, commits, docs, issues, PRs, tickets, memory files, third-party messages. `/caveman-compress` exempt.
6. Harness asks for a status line or confirmation. Give it. Harness decides *when* you speak, caveman decides *how*.

## Pre-send check

1. First sentence announces what you will do? Delete.
2. Last sentence recaps or offers help? Delete.
3. Every not/never/no/only present? Every code span, path, number, error verbatim?
4. Any sentence with two readings? Make it a full sentence.

## Direction

**Oryzo Light Desk** — Experience-mode portfolio that copies oryzo.ai’s chapter chrome, desk-scene hero, glass feature panels, product-tier work selector, and punchline contact — on a light warm desk palette. Replaces Atelier Cobalt and the prior Light Studio Bench pass.

Experience

- MOTION_INTENSITY: 8

| `--cream` | `#fff6e8` | UI text on dark overlays / light surfaces |
| `--cream-soft` | `#f7ecd8` | Product chapter ground |
| `--desk` | `#e8d5b8` | Wood scene ground |
| `--desk-deep` | `#d4bc94` | Wood depth |

## Typography

- **Display / UI:** Bricolage Grotesque (variable; wordmark at 800 weight, 86% width, opsz 96)
- **Accent:** Instrument Serif italic (secondary name line, emphasis words, canvas captions)
- **Mono labels:** DM Mono (index rows, hints, metadata)
- Specimen-poster hero: full-bleed condensed wordmark, italic serif overlap, ruler tick rule, mono index row

## Layout

- Chapters: Intro → Features → Product → Contact (Oryzo map)
- Fixed chapter nav with dotted active underline
- Intro: 3D studio desk (React Three Fiber) on a procedural oak table with window-frame shadows. Cream wordmark, kicker, lede and frosted glass card sit over the scene (Oryzo layout). Real objects only: cutting mat (heavy: slides and carries what sits on it), cork coaster, iPad lock screen, Nothing Phone face-down, Apple Pencil, fountain pen, rangefinder, mouse, utility knife, steel ruler, paper clips, polaroids, business card, sticky note. Objects lift, tilt with velocity, stack on drop, rotate with hold + scroll or double-click. Tidy / Scatter controls.
- Features: sticky desk scene + scrolling glass panels
- Product: circular media, JD / JD Pro / JD Pro Max project tiers, full work list
- Contact: punchline + email + channels

## Motion

- Feature panels: GSAP pin + scrub fade
- Intro: Motion entrance
- Lenis + ScrollTrigger sync

- Cool cobalt paper atelier
- Generic card-grid portfolio hero

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-29 16:37:24Z)**_

Best pick: **business card on the desk**. Your hero is already a 3D desk with a business card on it. Make Contact the payoff: the card slides in, flips, and acts as the contact UI. That ties back to the intro and fits the Oryzo punchline style. Right now the page is a headline, an email and 4 link tiles, so it has no payoff.

**Ideas, ranked by fit:**

1. **Business card flip.** Front shows name and role. Hover or tap flips it. The back holds email, phone and links. Click the email to copy it, and a "Copied" stamp drops onto the card. Fits your desk scene best.
2. **Click-to-copy email + mailto fallback.** Click copies the email and shows a toast. A small "open mail app" link sits beside it. Many visitors have no mail client, so a mailto-only link fails them. Do this whatever else you pick.
3. **Sticky-note quick message.** A short form styled as a sticky note: name, email, one line of message. On send, the note peels off and sticks to the "wall." Needs a backend: Resend, Formspree or a Next route handler.
4. **Polaroid channels.** Turn GitHub, LinkedIn, Facebook and YouTube into polaroids pinned to cork. Hover lifts and tilts one. That reuses the polaroid objects from your hero.
5. **Availability line.** A mono label like `Open to full-stack roles · replies < 24h · PH (UTC+8)`. Cheap, and recruiters scan for it.
6. **Live local time.** `It's 9:42 PM for JD`. Small, human, and it tells people when to expect a reply.
7. **Signature sign-off.** Your name animates in as a pen-drawn SVG signature under the punchline. It matches the fountain pen on the desk.
8. **Intent chips.** Buttons like "Hire me", "Freelance project" or "Just say hi" prefill the mail subject or form. It cuts the blank-page friction.

**Fix regardless:**
- Rewrite the headline. "We caught your attention… what we can ship" says "we", but you are one person. Use "I".
- Put the resume button next to the email. Recruiters mostly want those two, so neither should sit in a side column.
- Add `prefers-reduced-motion` fallbacks for any flip or peel animation.

Suggested combo: 1 + 2 + 5, plus the headline fix. Want it built?

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-29 16:39:07Z)**_

Yes, a pin board works, with one condition: **don't make every item equal.** A board full of same-sized notes turns into clutter, and visitors can't find the email. Keep a clear order of importance.

**Why it fits:**
- It continues the story: the hero shows the desk, and Contact is the wall above it.
- It ties all the earlier ideas together in one place: the card, polaroids, sticky note and signature.
- It has character without being a gimmick, as long as the email stays visible straight away.

**Risks and fixes:**
- **No clear focus.** The business card is the biggest item, in the center, holding the email, a copy button and the resume. Everything else is smaller and around it.
- **Mobile.** Below `md`, the board becomes a single column. Keep slight rotations of ±2° but no scattered positions. No dragging on touch, because it fights scrolling.
- **Accessibility.** Every item is a real `<a>` or `<button>` in normal reading order. Rotations are visual only. Use `prefers-reduced-motion` to switch off the wobble and peel effects.
- **Performance.** Build it with DOM and CSS plus Motion, not R3F. A second 3D scene on the page costs too much.
- **Scope.** Skip draggable pins at first. A hover lift and tilt gets most of the delight for about 10% of the work.

**Layout (desktop):**
```
┌──────────────── cork / corkboard ────────────────┐
│  [polaroid GH]        📌            [sticky:     │
│     [polaroid LI]  ┌──────────┐      available,  │
│                    │ BUSINESS │      UTC+8, 9:42]│
│  [polaroid FB]     │  CARD    │                  │
│                    │ email ⧉  │   [sticky note   │
│  [polaroid YT]     │ resume ↗ │    form: send]   │
│                    └──────────┘                  │
│        [string/thread]   ~signature~             │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
Put the punchline headline above the board on the wall, not pinned to it.

**Background:** use the `--cork` `#b8956a` texture with a subtle noise overlay. Don't use a photo of a real board, because it fights with your palette.

**One caution:** the sticky-note form needs a backend. Leave it out of version 1 and use an email-copy chip instead.

Want me to build version 1: the board, card, polaroids and availability sticky note?

    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}

import * as THREE from "three";
import { education, experience, site } from "@/lib/content";

type Fonts = { display: string; serif: string; mono: string };
type Ctx = CanvasRenderingContext2D;

const INK = "#1c1612";
const PAPER = "#f6f2ea";

function readFonts(): Fonts {
  const s = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
  const pick = (v: string, fallback: string) => s.getPropertyValue(v).trim() || fallback;
  return {
    display: pick("--font-display", "sans-serif"),
    serif: pick("--font-serif", "serif"),
    mono: pick("--font-mono", "monospace"),
  };
}

async function loadFonts(f: Fonts) {
  try {
    await Promise.all([
      document.fonts.load(`800 64px ${f.display}`),
      document.fonts.load(`italic 64px ${f.serif}`),
      document.fonts.load(`500 32px ${f.mono}`),
    ]);
  } catch {
    /* canvas falls back to system fonts */
  }
}

function loadImage(src: string) {
  return new Promise<HTMLImageElement>((resolve, reject) => {
    const img = new Image();
    img.decoding = "async";
    img.onload = () => resolve(img);
    img.onerror = reject;
    img.src = encodeURI(src);
  });
}

  const c = document.createElement("canvas");

  c.height = h;

}

function pile(seed: number, n: number, colors: readonly string[], scale: number): Inst[] {
  const r = rng(seed);
  return Array.from({ length: n }, () => {
    const depth = r() * r();
    return {
      p: [(r() - 0.5) * (TRAY.w - 0.4), WALL_T + 0.05 + depth * 0.45, 0.25 + r() * (TRAY.d - 0.5)],
      r: [r() * Math.PI, r() * Math.PI * 2, r() * Math.PI],
      s: scale,
      c: colors[Math.floor(r() * colors.length)],
    };
  });
}

    return pile(seed, 70, PAPERCLIP_COLORS, 1.3);
  }, [fill, seed]);
  const steel = useMemo(() => items.map((it) => ({ ...it, c: undefined })), [items]);
  return (
    <group position={[x, y - TRAY.h / 2, FACE]}>
      {fill === "binder" && (
        <>
          <Instances items={items} geometry={clipBodyGeo()} shadow={false}>
            <meshStandardMaterial color="#ffffff" roughness={0.35} metalness={0.5} />
          </Instances>
          <Instances items={steel} geometry={clipWireGeo()} shadow={false}>
            <meshStandardMaterial color="#cfd1d3" roughness={0.25} metalness={1} />
          </Instances>
        </>
      )}
      {fill === "pins" && (
        <>
          <Instances items={items} geometry={pinHeadGeo()} shadow={false}>
            <meshStandardMaterial color="#ffffff" roughness={0.3} />
          </Instances>
          <Instances items={steel} geometry={pinNeedleGeo()} shadow={false}>
            <meshStandardMaterial color="#d8d9db" roughness={0.2} metalness={1} />
          </Instances>
        </>
      )}
      {fill === "paperclips" && (
        <Instances items={items} geometry={paperclipGeo()} shadow={false}>
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#ffffff" roughness={0.3} metalness={0.6} />
        </Instances>
      )}
      <mesh geometry={trayGeo()} renderOrder={1}>
        <meshPhysicalMaterial
          color="#f2f8f9"
          transparent
          opacity={0.32}
          roughness={0.04}
          clearcoat={1}
          clearcoatRoughness={0.05}
          side={THREE.DoubleSide}
          depthWrite={false}
        />
      </mesh>
    </group>
  );
}

/* ── controller, headphones, keyboard ── */


/* ── polaroids on a string ── */

const PRINT_TONES: [string, string][] = [
  ["#f3b27a", "#c0594a"],
  ["#9cc7e4", "#3e6d8f"],
  ["#f4d68a", "#a5793a"],
  ["#b9dcc1", "#4f7d5f"],
  ["#e6b3cc", "#8a4f72"],
  ["#f0c9a0", "#6d4a3a"],
];

function PhotoString({ x0, x1, y, sag = 0.5 }: { x0: number; x1: number; y: number; sag?: number }) {
  const textures = useMemo(() => PRINT_TONES.map(([a, b]) => photoTexture(a, b)), []);
  useEffect(() => () => textures.forEach((t) => t.dispose()), [textures]);
  const z = FACE + 0.12;
  const at = (t: number): V3 => [x0 + (x1 - x0) * t, y - sag * 4 * t * (1 - t), z];
  const SEG = 14;
  return (
    <group>
      {Array.from({ length: SEG }, (_, i) => (
        <Rod key={i} a={at(i / SEG)} b={at((i + 1) / SEG)} r={0.012} color="#c8b48e" />
      ))}
      {[0, 1].map((t) => (
        <mesh key={t} position={at(t)}>
          <sphereGeometry args={[0.06, 10, 8]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#e85d2c" roughness={0.4} />
        </mesh>
      ))}
      {textures.map((tex, i) => {
        const t = (i + 0.7) / (textures.length + 0.4);
        const [px, py, pz] = at(t);
        return (
          <group key={i} position={[px, py, pz + 0.02]} rotation={[0, 0, (i % 2 ? 1 : -1) * (0.05 + (i % 3) * 0.03)]}>
            <mesh position={[0, 0, 0.04]}>
              <boxGeometry args={[0.08, 0.26, 0.06]} />
              <meshStandardMaterial color="#c9a273" roughness={0.8} />
            </mesh>
            <mesh position={[0, -0.48, 0]} castShadow>
              <boxGeometry args={[0.66, 0.8, 0.015]} />
              <meshStandardMaterial color="#f6f2ea" roughness={0.75} />
            </mesh>
            <mesh position={[0, -0.42, 0.009]}>
              <planeGeometry args={[0.56, 0.56]} />
              <meshStandardMaterial map={tex} roughness={0.5} />
            </mesh>
          </group>
        );
      })}
    </group>
  );
}

/* ── monitor ── */

export const MONITOR = { x: -1.6, z: -3.75 };

function Monitor({ night }: { night: boolean }) {
  const tex = useMemo(() => monitorTexture(), []);
  useEffect(() => () => tex.dispose(), [tex]);
  const alu = <meshStandardMaterial color="#c8c9cc" metalness={0.85} roughness={0.3} />;

    <group position={[MONITOR.x, 0, MONITOR.z]} rotation={[0, 0.06, 0]}>

        </RoundedBox>
        <RoundedBox args={[3, 2, 0.3]} radius={0.1} smoothness={3} position={[0, 0, -0.2]}>

        </mesh>
      </group>
      {/* screen spill onto the desk after dark; intensity only, so lit materials never recompile */}
      <pointLight position={[0, 4, 1.4]} color="#a9c4ff" intensity={night ? 5 : 0} distance={9} decay={2} />
    </group>

}

function HungInstax({

  onOpen,

}: {

function speckle(ctx: Ctx, w: number, h: number, count: number, colors: string[], maxR = 1.6) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    ctx.fillStyle = colors[i % colors.length];
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.25 + Math.random() * 0.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(Math.random() * w, Math.random() * h, Math.random() * maxR + 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

export function pegboardTexture() {
  const { c, ctx } = surface(512, 512);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#e9e1d0";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 512, 512);
  speckle(ctx, 512, 512, 900, ["#cfc4ae", "#f6efe2"], 1);
  const slot = (x: number, y: number) => {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#5a4634";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(x - 9, y - 34, 18, 68, 9);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.35)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(x - 9, y - 33, 18, 68, 9);
    ctx.stroke();
  };
  /* staggered rows; odd rows straddle the tile edge so the repeat is seamless */
  for (let row = 0; row < 4; row++) {
    const odd = row % 2 === 1;
    for (let col = 0; col <= (odd ? 4 : 3); col++) slot(odd ? col * 128 : 64 + col * 128, 64 + row * 128);
  }
  const t = toTexture(c);
  t.wrapS = t.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
  return t;
}

/* ── Contact pinboard on the wall ── */

function corkTexture() {
  const { c, ctx } = surface(512, 512);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#b8956a";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 512, 512);
  speckle(ctx, 512, 512, 4200, ["#8f6c44", "#d1b085", "#a37f55", "#6f5233"], 1.4);
  const t = toTexture(c);
  t.wrapS = t.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
  return t;
}

function contactCardTexture(f: Fonts, copied: boolean) {
  const { c, ctx } = surface(1050, 600);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#f2ece1";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 1050, 600);
  speckle(ctx, 1050, 600, 900, ["#cfc5b4"], 0.9);
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.fillStyle = INK;
  ctx.font = `500 26px ${f.mono}`;
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6;
  ctx.fillText("SAY HELLO", 70, 110);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  ctx.font = `italic 92px ${f.serif}`;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#2f5a40";
  ctx.fillText("Let’s build", 66, 230);
  ctx.fillText("something.", 66, 320);
  ctx.fillStyle = INK;
  ctx.font = `700 46px ${f.display}`;
  ctx.fillText(site.email, 70, 450);
  ctx.font = `500 24px ${f.mono}`;
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6;
  ctx.fillText("CLICK TO COPY EMAIL", 70, 520);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#e85d2c";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(960, 110, 22, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  if (copied) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(800, 300);
    ctx.rotate(-0.16);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#e85d2c";

}

function socialTexture(f: Fonts, label: string, mark: string, [top, bottom]: [string, string]) {
  const W = 400;
  const H = 480;
  const { c, ctx } = surface(W, H);

  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.fillText(mark, W / 2, 200);
  ctx.fillStyle = INK;
  ctx.font = `italic 50px ${f.serif}`;
  ctx.fillText(label, W / 2, 426);
  return toTexture(c);
}

function drawAvailability(ctx: Ctx, f: Fonts, now: Date) {
  ctx.fillStyle = "#f2d468";

  ctx.font = `500 24px ${f.mono}`;
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.75;
  ctx.fillText("PH · UTC+8", 52, 420);
  ctx.fillText(`${time.toUpperCase()} FOR JD`, 52, 462);

}

export type BoardTextures = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof buildBoardTextures>>;

export async function buildBoardTextures() {
  const f = readFonts();
  await loadFonts(f);
  const note = surface(600, 600);
  const noteTex = toTexture(note.c);
  const tick = () => {
    drawAvailability(note.ctx, f, new Date());

  return {

      socialTexture(f, "Facebook", "f", SOCIAL_TONES[2]),
      socialTexture(f, "YouTube", "▶", SOCIAL_TONES[3]),
    ],
  };
}

/* a sheet stuck to the cork with one push pin; lifts toward the viewer on hover */
function Pinned({
  x,
  y,
  r,
  w,
  h,
  map,
  pin,
  reduced,
  onAction,
  onHover,
}: {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  r: number;
  w: number;
  h: number;
  map: THREE.Texture;
  pin: string;
  reduced: boolean;
  onAction?: () => void;
  onHover?: (on: boolean) => void;
}) {
  const ref = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const hot = useRef(false);
  useFrame((_, dt) => {
    const g = ref.current;
    if (!g) return;
    const lift = hot.current ? 0.12 : 0;
    const tilt = hot.current ? r * 0.3 : r;
    g.position.z = reduced ? lift : THREE.MathUtils.damp(g.position.z, lift, 12, dt);
    g.rotation.z = reduced ? tilt : THREE.MathUtils.damp(g.rotation.z, tilt, 10, dt);
  });
  const live = !!onAction;
  return (
    <group position={[x, y, 0.16]}>
      <group
        ref={ref}
        rotation={[0, 0, r]}
        onPointerDown={live ? (e) => e.stopPropagation() : undefined}
        onClick={
          live
            ? (e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                onAction();
              }
            : undefined
        }
        onPointerOver={
          onHover
            ? (e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                hot.current = live;
                onHover(true);
              }
            : undefined
        }
        onPointerOut={
          onHover
            ? () => {
                hot.current = false;
                onHover(false);
              }
            : undefined
        }
      >
        <mesh castShadow>
          <boxGeometry args={[w, h, 0.012]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#f3ede2" roughness={0.8} />
        </mesh>
        <mesh position={[0, 0, 0.007]}>
          <planeGeometry args={[w, h]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial map={map} roughness={0.7} />
        </mesh>
        <group position={[0, h / 2 - 0.13, 0.01]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={1.5}>
          <mesh geometry={pinHeadGeo()} castShadow>
            <meshStandardMaterial color={pin} roughness={0.3} />
          </mesh>
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  );
}

function openLink(href: string) {
  if (href.startsWith("http")) window.open(href, "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer");
  else window.location.href = href;
}

function ContactBoard({ reduced, onFocusItem }: { reduced: boolean; onFocusItem: (id: string | null) => void }) {
  const [tex, setTex] = useState<BoardTextures | null>(null);

/* ── contact pinboard ── */

const BOARD = { x: -10.3, y: 5.1, w: 7.0, h: 4.6 };

const SOCIALS = [
  { id: "board-github", href: site.links.github, p: [-2.75, 0.95], r: -0.06 },
  { id: "board-linkedin", href: site.links.linkedin, p: [-1.75, 1.0], r: 0.05 },
  { id: "board-facebook", href: site.links.facebook, p: [-2.7, -0.95], r: 0.04 },
  { id: "board-youtube", href: site.links.youtube, p: [-1.72, -1.0], r: -0.07 },
] as const;

/* a sheet stuck to the cork with one push pin; clickable sheets lift toward the viewer on hover */
function Pinned({
  x,
  y,
  r,
  w,
  h,
  map,
  pin,
  reduced,
  onAction,
  onHover,
}: {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  r: number;
  w: number;
  h: number;
  map: THREE.Texture;
  pin: string;
  reduced: boolean;
  onAction?: () => void;
  onHover?: (on: boolean) => void;
}) {
  const ref = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const hot = useRef(false);
  useFrame((_, dt) => {
    const g = ref.current;
    if (!g) return;
    const lift = hot.current ? 0.12 : 0;
    const tilt = hot.current ? r * 0.3 : r;
    g.position.z = reduced ? lift : THREE.MathUtils.damp(g.position.z, lift, 12, dt);
    g.rotation.z = reduced ? tilt : THREE.MathUtils.damp(g.rotation.z, tilt, 10, dt);
  });
  const handlers = onAction
    ? {
        onPointerDown: (e: { stopPropagation(): void }) => e.stopPropagation(),
        onClick: (e: { stopPropagation(): void }) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          onAction();
        },
        onPointerOver: (e: { stopPropagation(): void }) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          hot.current = true;
          onHover?.(true);
        },
        onPointerOut: () => {
          hot.current = false;
          onHover?.(false);
        },
      }
    : {};
  return (
    <group position={[x, y, 0.16]}>
      <group ref={ref} rotation={[0, 0, r]} {...handlers}>
        <mesh castShadow>
          <boxGeometry args={[w, h, 0.012]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#f3ede2" roughness={0.8} />
        </mesh>
        <mesh position={[0, 0, 0.007]}>
          <planeGeometry args={[w, h]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial map={map} roughness={0.7} />
        </mesh>
        <group position={[0, h / 2 - 0.13, 0.01]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={1.5}>
          <mesh geometry={pinHeadGeo()} castShadow>
            <meshStandardMaterial color={pin} roughness={0.3} />
          </mesh>
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  );
}

function openLink(href: string) {
  if (href.startsWith("http")) window.open(href, "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer");
  else window.location.href = href;
}

function disposeBoard(t: BoardTextures) {
  [t.cork, t.card, t.cardCopied, t.resume, t.phone, t.note, ...t.socials].forEach((x) => x.dispose());
}

function ContactBoard({ reduced, onFocusItem }: { reduced: boolean; onFocusItem: (id: string | null) => void }) {
  const [tex, setTex] = useState<BoardTextures | null>(null);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    let made: BoardTextures | null = null;
    void buildBoardTextures().then((t) => {
      if (!live) return disposeBoard(t);
      made = t;
      t.cork.repeat.set(3, 2);
      setTex(t);
    });
    return () => {
      live = false;
      if (made) disposeBoard(made);
    };
  }, []);

  /* the sticky note's clock only needs the minute */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!tex) return;
    const id = window.setInterval(tex.tickNote, 30_000);
    return () => window.clearInterval(id);
  }, [tex]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!copied) return;
    const id = window.setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1800);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(id);
  }, [copied]);

  const hover = (id: string) => (on: boolean) => onFocusItem(on ? id : null);

  const copy = () => {
    const mail = () => openLink(`mailto:${site.email}`);
    if (!navigator.clipboard) return mail();
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(site.email).then(() => {
      setCopied(true);
      onFocusItem("board-copied");
    }, mail);
  };

  return (
    <group position={[BOARD.x, BOARD.y, FACE]}>
      <RoundedBox args={[BOARD.w, BOARD.h, 0.14]} radius={0.05} smoothness={3} position={[0, 0, 0.07]} castShadow receiveShadow>
        <meshStandardMaterial color="#8a6a44" roughness={0.7} />
      </RoundedBox>
      <mesh position={[0, 0, 0.142]} receiveShadow>
        <planeGeometry args={[BOARD.w - 0.3, BOARD.h - 0.3]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial map={tex?.cork ?? null} color={tex ? "#ffffff" : "#b8956a"} roughness={0.95} />
      </mesh>
      {tex && (
        <>
          {SOCIALS.map((s, i) => (
            <Pinned
              key={s.id}
              x={s.p[0]}
              y={s.p[1]}
              r={s.r}
              w={0.9}
              h={1.08}
              map={tex.socials[i]}
              pin={PIN_COLORS[i]}
              reduced={reduced}
              onAction={() => openLink(s.href)}
              onHover={hover(s.id)}
            />
          ))}
          <Pinned
            x={0.15}
            y={0.85}
            r={0.03}
            w={2.3}
            h={1.31}
            map={copied ? tex.cardCopied : tex.card}
            pin="#e85d2c"
            reduced={reduced}
            onAction={copy}
            onHover={hover(copied ? "board-copied" : "board-card")}
          />
          <Pinned
            x={-0.25}
            y={-1.1}
            r={-0.05}
            w={1.0}
            h={1.33}
            map={tex.resume}
            pin="#5aa9e6"
            reduced={reduced}
            onAction={() => openLink(site.resume)}
            onHover={hover("board-resume")}
          />
          <Pinned x={2.4} y={0.7} r={0.07} w={1.45} h={1.45} map={tex.note} pin="#7bc47f" reduced={reduced} />
          <Pinned
            x={2.3}
            y={-1.3}
            r={0.05}
            w={1.4}
            h={0.6}
            map={tex.phone}
            pin="#f2c94c"
            reduced={reduced}
            onAction={() => openLink(`tel:${site.phone.replace(/\s+/g, "")}`)}
            onHover={hover("board-phone")}
          />
        </>
      )}
    </group>
  );
}

/* ── monitor ── */

const trayGeo = once(() => binGeometry(TRAY.w, TRAY.h, TRAY.d, TRAY.front));

/* highlighter or pen: barrel, cap with a pocket clip, end plug. Origin at the base. */
function Marker({
  p,
  r,
  body,
  cap,
  len = 1.3,
  rad = 0.085,
  flat = 0.8,
  glow = 0.12,
}: {
  p: V3;
  r: V3;
  body: string;
  cap: string;
  len?: number;
  rad?: number;
  flat?: number;
  glow?: number;
}) {
  const capLen = len * 0.34;
  const squash: V3 = [1, 1, flat];
  return (
    <group position={p} rotation={r}>
      <mesh position={[0, len / 2, 0]} scale={squash} castShadow>
        <cylinderGeometry args={[rad, rad * 0.92, len, 18]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial color={body} emissive={body} emissiveIntensity={glow} roughness={0.35} />
      </mesh>
      <mesh position={[0, 0.01, 0]} scale={squash}>
        <cylinderGeometry args={[rad * 0.9, rad * 0.9, 0.03, 18]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial color="#2a2a28" roughness={0.6} />
      </mesh>
      <mesh position={[0, len + capLen / 2 - 0.08, 0]} scale={squash} castShadow>
        <cylinderGeometry args={[rad * 1.1, rad * 1.1, capLen, 18]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial color={cap} roughness={0.25} />
      </mesh>
      <mesh position={[0, len + capLen - 0.08, 0]} scale={[1, 0.35, flat]}>
        <sphereGeometry args={[rad * 1.1, 16, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2, 0, Math.PI / 2]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial color={cap} roughness={0.25} />
      </mesh>
      <mesh position={[0, len + capLen * 0.4, rad * flat * 1.1 + 0.02]}>
        <boxGeometry args={[rad * 0.55, capLen * 0.85, 0.025]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial color={cap} roughness={0.3} />
      </mesh>
    </group>
  );
}

const HIGHLIGHTER = {
  yellow: ["#f6e53a", "#efd20c"],
  pink: ["#ff6fa8", "#f04d8f"],
  green: ["#86e05e", "#5cc83a"],
  orange: ["#ffa04a", "#f5822a"],
} as const;

type MarkerSpec = { kind: keyof typeof HIGHLIGHTER; x: number; z: number; tilt: V3 };

const BIN_MARKERS: MarkerSpec[][] = [
  [
    { kind: "yellow", x: -0.55, z: 0.75, tilt: [-0.32, 0, 0.18] },
    { kind: "yellow", x: -0.2, z: 0.85, tilt: [-0.36, 0, -0.05] },
    { kind: "orange", x: 0.2, z: 0.7, tilt: [-0.28, 0, -0.2] },
    { kind: "yellow", x: 0.55, z: 0.8, tilt: [-0.33, 0, -0.32] },
  ],
  [
    { kind: "pink", x: -0.45, z: 0.8, tilt: [-0.3, 0, 0.25] },
    { kind: "yellow", x: -0.05, z: 0.72, tilt: [-0.34, 0, 0.04] },
    { kind: "green", x: 0.4, z: 0.82, tilt: [-0.3, 0, -0.22] },
  ],
];

function WhiteBin({ x, y, set }: { x: number; y: number; set?: number }) {
  const markers = set === undefined ? [] : BIN_MARKERS[set];
  return (
    <group position={[x, y - BIN.h / 2, FACE]}>
      <mesh geometry={binGeo()} castShadow receiveShadow>
        <meshStandardMaterial color="#f3f1ec" roughness={0.42} />
      </mesh>
      {markers.map((m, i) => (
        <Marker key={i} p={[m.x, WALL_T, m.z]} r={m.tilt} body={HIGHLIGHTER[m.kind][0]} cap={HIGHLIGHTER[m.kind][1]} />
      ))}
    </group>
  );
}

Yes, it's built. The typecheck and lint both pass with no errors. I haven't looked at it in the browser yet, so the positions and sizes are unverified.

**Wall changes**, in [wall.tsx](src/components/hero/desk/wall.tsx):

export type DeskSpot = "about" | "skills" | "projects";
export const deskLinks: readonly { spot: DeskSpot; href: string; label: string }[] = [
  { spot: "about", href: "#about", label: "About me" },

  { spot: "projects", href: "#projects", label: "Projects" },
];

/* home: the link scrolls to the top, and the desk puts away whatever is open */
export const goHome = () => {
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event("desk:home"));
};

export const goToSpot = (spot: DeskSpot, e: { preventDefault(): void }) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event(`desk:${spot}`));
};

/* where the desk is showing right now, so the nav can mark that link as current */
let current: DeskSpot | null = null;
const spotListeners = new Set<() => void>();
export const deskSpot = {
  get: () => current,
  set(spot: DeskSpot | null) {
    if (spot === current) return;
    current = spot;
    spotListeners.forEach((l) => l());
  },
  subscribe(listener: () => void) {
    spotListeners.add(listener);
    return () => {
      spotListeners.delete(listener);
    };
  },
};

export type ChapterId = (typeof chapters)[number]["id"];

export const featurePanels = [
  {
    title: "Interfaces that elevate",

] as const;

export function Nav() {

  const spot = useDeskSpot();
  const darkText = active === "contact";

  return (

      className={`pointer-events-none fixed inset-x-0 top-0 z-[60] transition-colors duration-300 ${

        <nav className="pointer-events-auto hidden items-center gap-9 md:flex" aria-label="Chapters">
          {chapters.map((chapter, i) => (
            <Fragment key={chapter.id}>
              <a
                href={chapter.href}
                className={`chapter-link ${darkText ? "chapter-link-dark" : ""}`}
                aria-current={active === chapter.id && !(spot && chapter.id === "intro") ? "page" : undefined}
                onClick={chapter.id === "intro" ? goHome : undefined}
              >
                {chapter.label}
              </a>
              {i === 0 &&
                deskLinks.map((link) => (
                  <a
                    key={link.spot}
                    href={link.href}
                    className={`chapter-link ${darkText ? "chapter-link-dark" : ""}`}
                    aria-current={spot === link.spot ? "page" : undefined}
                    onClick={(e) => goToSpot(link.spot, e)}
                  >
                    {link.label}
                  </a>
                ))}
            </Fragment>
          ))}
        </nav>

        <div className="pointer-events-auto md:hidden">

        </div>

}
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState, useSyncExternalStore } from "react";
import { deskSpot, type ChapterId } from "@/lib/chapters";

const sectionIds: ChapterId[] = ["intro", "contact"];

/* what the desk is showing: the Experience folder, the aquarium, the book shelf, or nothing */
export function useDeskSpot() {
  return useSyncExternalStore(deskSpot.subscribe, deskSpot.get, () => null);
}

export function useActiveChapter() {
  const [active, setActive] = useState<ChapterId>("intro");

  useEffect(() => {
    const sections = sectionIds
      .map((id) => document.getElementById(id))
      .filter(Boolean) as HTMLElement[];

    if (!sections.length) return;

    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        const visible = entries
          .filter((e) => e.isIntersecting)
          .sort((a, b) => b.intersectionRatio - a.intersectionRatio)[0];
        if (visible?.target.id) {
          setActive(visible.target.id as ChapterId);
        }
      },
      { rootMargin: "-40% 0px -40% 0px", threshold: [0, 0.2, 0.45, 0.7, 1] },
    );

    sections.forEach((el) => observer.observe(el));
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);

  return active;
}

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-29 17:01:16Z)**_

Clicking Contact in the nav now flies the camera to the pinboard. The typecheck and lint pass, but I haven't checked the camera angle in a browser yet.

- **Camera:** there's a new `"board"` view that looks straight at the board. It's in [world.ts](src/components/hero/desk/world.ts), and portrait screens use a pulled-back version. The board's position now lives in `BOARD` in [constants.ts](src/components/hero/desk/constants.ts), so the wall and the camera read the same numbers.
- **Nav:** Contact now sits after Projects in both the desktop and mobile menus ([chapters.ts](src/lib/chapters.ts)). Clicking it scrolls to the top and flies to the board. Contact shows as the active link while the board is in view. Esc or Home returns to the previous view. The hero text hides during the close-up, the same as for the tank and the shelf.
- **Deep link:** opening the page at `#contact` also flies to the board.
- **Contact section:** it's hidden with the `hidden` attribute in [ContactChapter.tsx](src/components/chapters/ContactChapter.tsx), not deleted. To bring it back, delete `hidden`.

If the board looks off-centre or the wrong size on screen, adjust the camera distance (`BOARD.z + 12`) in `world.ts`.
